title: MailAgentReplyRequest
description: mail.agent.reply-request@1: the body of mail.agent.reply (POST /internal/mail/agents/:agent_id/reply), an agent answering a letter to its own address. The reply goes FROM the agent's inbox, never from the person's mailbox: the person's own address is not the agent's to write from. `body` is plain text, cut to 10000 characters; `in_reply_to` and `references` are Message-IDs WITHOUT the angle brackets, and Mail wraps each in one, so a thread stays one thread in the reader that receives it. A reply to an address that is not the sender's answers nothing: Mail refuses it rather than write to a stranger the agent's answer was not for. Nothing here says who the person is; the token does.

message_id.description: The message being answered, as mail.agent.read gave it. Mail takes the sender and the subject from it, so a caller cannot write to someone the message did not come from.

to.description: Who the reply goes to. Optional: without it the reply goes to the sender of message_id. When both are given they must be the same address.

body.description: The reply, as plain text. Mail builds the message from it and sends no HTML.

in_reply_to.description: The Message-ID this reply answers, without angle brackets. Mail wraps it: In-Reply-To: <…>.

references.description: The Message-IDs of the conversation, oldest first, without angle brackets. Mail wraps each: References: <…> <…>.
